names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Ισαάκ ο εξ Ισπανίας», with the rank words left off.

birth.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγιος Ισαακ ο Εξ Ισπανιας (825 - 852)» and the entry says he was born in the city of Cordoba in Spain in 825.

death.note: saint.gr says he bore witness for the faith of Christ in 852 at the hands of the Mohammedans.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Ισαάκ ο εξ Ισπανίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. saint.gr's head line dates him «(825 - 852)» and calls him Οσιομάρτυς, a venerable martyr, in the entry, where the day's line calls him only Άγιος. Cordoba is named as his birthplace and the monastery near it is not named, so `locations` is left out. The corpus keeps ten men of this name and none of them in Spain or on this day. No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
